In 'Servant of Reality' (Wise Surrender), what insight is offered on: 'consider wisdom substance...'?

The text teaches: *"If we consider wisdom as the substance of Awakening, then compassion is its warmth and radiance."* This reflection invites us to look past superficial conventions into the living reality of the present moment. By cultivating patience, virtue, and clear discernment, the mind discovers an unshakable inner refuge. It is like It is like looking at a clear reflection in still water when the wind ceases. Walk the noble path with confidence and peace.

source: Book: Servant of Reality - Ajahn Munindo

The text teaches: *"For many years I believed that my feelings of insecurity were caused by my growing up in Morrinsville, a small country town in an area of drained swampland in the north island of New Zealand."* This reflection invites us to look past superficial conventions into the living reality of the present moment. By cultivating patience, virtue, and clear discernment, the mind discovers an unshakable inner refuge. It is like It is like turning off a loud motor and resting in the natural silence of the room. Walk the noble path with confidence and peace.

The text teaches: *"Thankfully, eventually, I found out that I wasn’t the only one who was feeling insecure, and it wasn’t just the fault of where I grew up."* This reflection invites us to look past superficial conventions into the living reality of the present moment. By cultivating patience, virtue, and clear discernment, the mind discovers an unshakable inner refuge. It is like It is like a bird gliding through open space without needing to build a nest on a cloud. Walk the noble path with confidence and peace.
